    AI Overview
    To create a QR code for your form, first copy your form's live link or URL. Then, paste the link into a free QR code generator (like QR Code Generator or Jotform's QR Generator) and click Generate to download the image. 
    Step-by-Step Instructions
    1. Get Your Form's URL
    • Google Forms: Open your form, click the Send button in the top right, select the paperclip icon (Link) to copy the URL, and shorten it if desired.
    • Microsoft Forms: Click Collect Responses, copy the link, or locate the QR code icon directly in the sharing menu to download a QR code natively. 
    2. Generate the QR Code
    • Navigate to a free QR generator tool like QR Code Generator or use native tools within Canva.
    • Paste the copied URL into the generator's text field.
    • Select Download to save the QR code as a PNG or JPG file. 
    For a visual guide on using a dedicated generator website:
    1:42
    How To Make A QR Code For A Google Form - Full Guide
    GuideRealm
    YouTube · Aug 25, 2024
    3. Using Google Chrome's Built-In Generator
    If you prefer not to use an external website, you can use Google Chrome's built-in tool: 
    1. Open your form in your Chrome browser.
    2. Click the three dots (menu icon) in the top-right corner of Chrome.
    3. Select Cast, save and share -> Create QR code.
    4. Click Download to save the QR image to your device.
